## Analyzer Architecture Summary

llm-d-inference-scheduler is a Kubernetes component. managing 2 CRD(s)\: InferenceModelRewrite, InferenceObjective. deploying 6 workload(s) (${EPP\_NAME}, istiod-llm-d-gateway, vllm-d, vllm-e, vllm-p, 0) with 7 container(s). watching 4 resource type(s). exposing 7 service(s) on ports\: 15010, 15012, 15014, 15021, 443, 5557, 80, 8080, 9002, 9003, 9090. Dockerfile EXPOSE ports\: 5557, 9002, 9003, 9090. with 5 webhook(s) (1 validating, 4 mutating). with 1 HorizontalPodAutoscaler(s). with 704 operator config constants (6 image references, 4 env vars). exposing 79 Prometheus metrics. with 9 ingress route(s). integrates with Istio, Prometheus, management relationship via labels/annotations. kustomize overlays\: config/crd. mounts 2 ConfigMap(s) as volumes\: epp-config, istio-ca-root-cert.
